verdict.rationale: Omnara is explicitly open-source (Apache 2.0) and documented as 'free to self-host and build on,' with self-hosted deployments able to query Postgres directly for agent history, and agents can run on any connected machine (laptop or server) — consistent with local, container, or VM deployment. Missing for 10: explicit Docker/Kubernetes/VM deployment guides or configs, and independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-hosted setup.
